- Target p95 / p99 latency targets (ms) and typical sequence length
- Any strict compliance/network constraints (VPC / on-prem)

Hi Samir / Rebecca — Alex here (Solutions Engineer, Infra). Thanks for the details — that’s helpful and well within what we typically size for Dedicated pools. A few quick notes before the demo so we can make the 45 minutes count:

1) Runbook & test plan: we can do a short live throughput check (10–15 minutes) if you can allow a test endpoint from within your VPC or via a temporary peered test subnet. Otherwise we can replay a synthetic load from our private test harness.
2) Kernel/config notes: for seq len 1024 we’ll recommend a quantization + batching profile and a KV cache window tuned to your concurrency shape. We’ll bring a recommended config to the call.
3) Technical pre-call: would you be open to a 15-min pre-call with Laura to confirm network egress and IAM/KMS requirements? That saves time during the demo.

I’m available for the Wed 15:00 PST slot — I’ll hold that and send a calendar invite with a short agenda: intro (5), architecture sizing (15), demo & throughput check (20), next steps (5). If Wed is final I’ll also include a placeholder Zoom link.

Calendar options:
- Wed Oct 14, 15:00 PST (preferred)
- Thu Oct 15, 10:00 PST (fallback)
